question.text: Interest Rate Swap (IRS) in India commonly references which floating rate?

explanation.text: The Logic: Indian IRS market is dominated by MIBOR-OIS (Overnight Index Swap) swaps, with MIBOR as the reference floating rate. MIFOR (offshore) is another. The Trap: Repo rate is used for policy anchoring but not as the IRS reference; US Prime is for USD swaps, not INR. Cross-Exam Context: IV Ch 5 covers IRS in depth; XXI-B expects working knowledge. Manager's Pro-Tip: For long-dated INR hedging, the INBMK (G-Sec benchmark) swaps are deeper than MIBOR; for short-dated, MIBOR-OIS is the liquid product.
